# AE Factory Sales

> Houston maker and installer of patio enclosures and screens for existing covered patios: tinted polycarbonate 3-season rooms (Clearfixed, Clearfold), Hexfold folding honeycomb aluminum screens, Fixed Screen 304 stainless steel screens, and the Hybrid (folding polycarbonate panels plus mesh in one system). Made in our Houston factory and installed by our own crew, never subcontracted. Showroom: 2609 William Tell St, Houston, TX 77093. Phone (713) 791-8073. info@aefactorysales.com. Building patio enclosures in Houston since 2022.

Key facts (as of November 2026):
- Products: patio enclosures and screens are the only products sold. Five systems.
- Installed prices per sq ft of opening (open wall area filled, not floor area), before sales tax: Fixed Screen from $24, Hexfold from $28, Clearfixed from $31, Clearfold from $40, Hybrid from $56. Doggy door add-on $200 (small, medium or large).
- Example: a 16 × 14 ft covered patio with two open sides (about 240 sq ft of openings) runs about $5,760 in Fixed Screen, $6,720 in Hexfold, $7,440 in Clearfixed or $9,600 in Clearfold.
- Quote: free design visit at the home; the quote is given on site, then emailed within 24 hours. Online price estimate at /free-quote/.
- Install: within a month of the order (after HOA approval, if needed), by AE's own crew. Most installs take one day on site.
- Payment: 50% deposit when the order is placed; the balance is due before installation, after the customer is shown the finished order.
- Warranty: lifetime on the frame for the original owner while they own the home (not transferable), plus 5 years on all parts. Covers normal wear and tear; excludes accidents, intentional damage and acts of God. Service and warranty work is handled by our Houston factory.
- Frames (all systems): heat-welded corners; PVC and fiber blend with an aluminum rod core and a scratch-resistant ceramic coating. Colors: Night Gray or Bright White.
- Hexfold: pleated honeycomb aluminum mesh (standard; about 115 holes per sq in), no posts, opens and closes by hand with no motor, so it works in a power outage. Up to 10 ft per pull, or 20 ft wide with two pulls meeting in the middle.
- Fixed Screen: 304 stainless steel mesh (standard, not an upgrade), panels up to 4 × 11.5 ft each, arches available, doggy door available.
- Clearfixed: fixed tinted polycarbonate panels up to 4 × 11.5 ft each (4 mm), can be cut into arches and angles.
- Clearfold: folding tinted polycarbonate panels, about half the thickness of Clearfixed. Up to 5 ft per pull, or 10 ft meeting in the middle. Water stop included.
- Hybrid: folding polycarbonate panels and mesh in one system. Up to 9.8 ft per side, or 19.7 ft wide × 11.5 ft tall meeting in the middle. Water stop included.
- Low track: 3/8 in, solid 304 stainless steel, under the 1/2 in threshold height allowed in the ADA standards. Standard (with a ramp) on openings 16.5 ft and wider; an add-on, quoted on site, for narrower openings, where the standard track is 5/8 in tall. Folding leaves are equal width (about 5 in) and stack to about 0.2 in each.
- Polycarbonate: tinted only, Smokey Gray or Industrial Blue. UV protection on both sides plus a hard coat. A 4 mm Smokey Gray panel measured 48% visible light transmission and 0.45 SHGC.
- Wind: in our Houston factory's in-house wind tunnel test, a polycarbonate panel withstood 50 mph winds (Beaufort 9). This is not a hurricane rating.
- Rain: rubber gaskets and custom U-channels stop light rain; heavy wind-driven rain can let a little in.
- Air conditioning: not built in and the room is not insulated. Adding AC is optional, and closed panels help hold cooled air in.
- Permits: these are not permanent fixtures, so no city permit is needed. HOA approval may apply; AE provides drawings, colors and product details for the application.
- Care: a light lubricant such as WD-40 in the top track housing twice a year, shown at the final walkthrough.
- Screen systems were tested for four years on Houston job sites and in the factory.
- Showroom: open 9 am to 5 pm, 7 days a week, by appointment. Call (713) 791-8073 to book. Customer parking on site. The team brings 25 years from the window and door business.
- Service area: Houston and the greater Houston area, including Katy, Sugar Land, Cypress, The Woodlands, Pearland, Spring, Richmond, Conroe, Fulshear and Baytown. Full list at /service-area/.
